635:t_135:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If you say you aren't our enemies, get out of the way already! We're not fighting because we enjoy it!」

635:t_136:0.en:
$n
「So many people risked their lives to protect Earth! Whatever you are, we can't hand it over to you!」

635:t_136:1.en:
$n
「We'll do it! That's what $c is here for!!」

635:t_137:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「We must move beyond fighting...! That is the task entrusted to me... no, surely to all of humanity!」

635:t_137:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll do it! I'm an $$イノベイター$$... I exist for that purpose!」

635:t_138:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The $$来たるべき対話$$... That is $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s true mission...)

635:t_138:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Then we'll do it...! We'll stake everything we've done on this battle!)

635:t_139:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$! That space monster...!」

635:t_139:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I know, Big Sis! It looks the same as the ones we've fought, but its power is on a whole different level!」

635:t_139:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Are you saying it's an evolved space monster!?」

635:t_139:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then we'll just have to surpass it!」

635:t_139:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! Now is the time for $$ガンバスター$$ to blaze like a flame!!」

635:t_140:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「This space monster...! It's tougher than any we've faced...!」

635:t_140:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「This space monster...! It's tougher than any we've faced...!」

635:t_140:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「This space monster...! It's tougher than any we've faced...!」

635:t_140:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But neither $$ノノ$$ nor anyone else will give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth lives in our hearts, we will never lose!!」

635:t_140:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But neither $$ノノ$$ nor anyone else will give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth lives in our hearts, we will never lose!!」

635:t_140:5.en:

「But neither $$ノノ$$ nor anyone else will give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth lives in our hearts, we will never lose!!」

635:t_141:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Its power is off the charts...! Can we... can humanity defeat this thing!?」

635:t_141:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is no time for doubts! Earth is right behind us!」

635:t_141:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's do this! Defeating the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is $$フラタニティ$$'s duty!!」

635:t_142:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Those sisters... I can't believe they thought a monster like this was their savior...」

635:t_142:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Damn it...! I was a fool to believe people like them!」

635:t_143:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「I couldn't stand them, but those sisters were fellow $$トップレス$$, too!」

635:t_143:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Here I come! I'll defeat you here, to avenge the sisters and protect Earth!」

635:t_144:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Come and get me! You're a monster from space? Well, we've got $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!」

635:t_144:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「We've got you beat for size! Now we'll see whose fighting spirit wins!!」

635:t_145:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Maybe one day we'll be able to understand you, too...!」

635:t_145:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「But right now, I'll fight to protect the future! That is my mission... $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s mission!!」

635:t_146:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ダヤッカ$$, $$リーロン$$, $$ロージェノム$$, $$アーテンボロー$$! $$テツカン$$, $$ガバル$$, $$シベラ$$!」

635:t_146:2.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We're ready whenever you are!」

635:t_146:3.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Now is the time for my new battle.」

635:t_146:4.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「I'll blast them away!」

635:t_146:5.en:
$$シベラ$$
「The enemy is right in front of us!」

635:t_146:7.en:
$$テツカン$$
「And plenty of fighting spirit!」

635:t_146:8.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Our dependable friends are back.」

635:t_146:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go! We'll put the infinite power born from our bonds into our drill!」

635:t_146:12.en:
$$シモン$$
